notes: Engine library (ilib) classes. Many labels in this group were grab-bags over a few real objects; the real objects are: Audio (global 0xa50ec8), Streamer (0xa5ce00) + FileLoader (0x164), Input (0xd69, mouse/keyboard/joystick), MouseCursor (0x204), plus the hand-typed File/FileMem/FileTxt/Database/ResourceDb/DynArray/DynArrayB/GameSet/String/Mem/Misc/Blob. Label aliases (Mouse, InputQueue, EventQueue, Buttons, CdAudio, DSound, SoundSys, SoundStreams, AudioStream, PalStream, SoundThread, Loader, FilePath, DataBase, DbFile, Rand, Pager, SortedList) are kept as classes with base = the real class and no fields. Arrays of embedded structs are spelled as one member per element (e.g. Input event_queue[0..19]). Persisted/OS-sized fields to watch on x64: DynArray header (0x1d bytes written raw), Win32 HANDLEs (File::file_handle, FileLoader::handle, Streamer events), Streamer::lock (CRITICAL_SECTION), COM pointers in Audio/Input/Joystick.
